lineage.core_design: sealed notices, dawn tags, and nursery transfer conditions

chapters.title: Notice knowledge condition
chapters.body: Before dawn, the sealed opal notice is the only permitted channel for the Lantern Ward transfer; a person knows the transfer only after signing that notice.

chapters.title: Notice receipt book
chapters.body: At 04:50 the receipt book shows the sealed opal notice signed only by Rhea Mott; Cian Dusk has no notice receipt.

chapters.title: Dawn-tag convention
chapters.body: A transfer tagged afterglow is logged after the ward's dawn bell has rung.

chapters.title: Transfer tag
chapters.body: The Moss Dock transfer entry is tagged afterglow.

chapters.title: Cradle fabric
chapters.body: The Lantern Ward cradle is lined with amber felt; a dock blanket is described as green wool.

chapters.title: Dock ledger shelf
chapters.body: Rhea Mott files the Moss Dock ledger in the Lantern Ward cabinet.

chapters.title: Pending count
chapters.body: The nursery count sheet lists seedlings examined but leaves the surviving total blank.

chapters.title: Unidentified parcel
chapters.body: A parcel reached Moss Dock, but its seal mark does not identify the nursery sender.
